sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: If you've asked your employer for a raise recently, Taurus, the astral energy indicates that you can expect to receive one soon. Your employer is greatly impressed with your efforts, and probably thinking that you might be setting your sights elsewhere. Opportunities may certainly appear, although this is obviously not the time to decide. Take some time to really think and consider everything carefully.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Acknowledge and release emotional blockages as Luna aspects the nodes of fate before exiting your sign. The Gemini Moon aligns with Mars, Neptune, and Pluto as afternoon unfolds, expanding your capacity to act on your dreams. If you feel overwhelmed or unmotivated, inhale determination and exhale apprehension. Smart moves offer instant gratification once Luna and Uranus join forces later tonight. Steady your thoughts then take a leap of faith to harness these vibes.

sources.text: A beneficial day to work on things that will improve your health.
